reddit.title: Improved Music Transitions in Provincia
reddit.body: We're excited to share that we've made significant improvements to the music transitions in Provincia! No more hard cuts between day, night, and combat music. Our new system uses a long equal-power self-crossfade to create a seamless listening experience. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops

steam.title: Provincia Music Update: Smooth Transitions
steam.body: We're thrilled to announce that we've enhanced the music experience in Provincia! Our new audio system eliminates hard cuts between day, night, and combat tracks, introducing a seamless transition with a long equal-power self-crossfade. Dive into the details of this update and how it improves your gameplay experience!
